architectural_clarification_critical.headline: The task title conflates two distinct concepts in this codebase — owner D8 day must pick which one.

concept_a_senangpay_online_gateway.what: SenangPay = online card payment gateway. Customer pays via senangpay.com.my checkout (browser redirect or hosted page). SenangPay's servers POST an HMAC-signed webhook back to /payment/senangpay-webhook/.
concept_a_senangpay_online_gateway.credentials_storage: DB table `gateway_options` (senangpay_secret_key, senangpay_merchant_id, senangpay_mode, senangpay_status). Resolved via PaymentGateway::with('gatewayOptions')->where('slug','senangpay'). NOT .env / NOT config files.
concept_a_senangpay_online_gateway.signature_verification: HMAC-SHA-256 over canonical `status_id|order_id|transaction_id|msg` with merchant secret. hash_equals timing-safe. Invalid sig → 400 (no retry). Missing sig → 400. Missing secret → 500 misconfigured.
concept_a_senangpay_online_gateway.idempotency_floor: WebhookEvent::firstOrCreate(provider=senangpay, webhook_id=$transaction_id) + DB UNIQUE(provider, webhook_id). Duplicate returns 200 status='duplicate_ignored' so SenangPay stops retrying.
concept_a_senangpay_online_gateway.branch_isolation: WebhookEvent is intentionally global (no BranchScope). order_id is mapped post-processing, inheriting branch from Order row.
concept_a_senangpay_online_gateway.rate_limit: throttle:60,1 (60 req/min/IP) — added Wave 1 P1 SYNC-RED-01 2026-05-18 to mitigate LAN HMAC-CPU DoS.

concept_b_physical_tpe_at_kiosk.what: Le Cayenne kiosk physical card-payment terminal (Ingenico/Verifone/Senangpay-POS-device) driven by Electron app. After local hardware approval, the Electron app POSTs into the kiosk's Laravel backend at /api/frontend/order/{id}/payment-confirm to declare PAID server-side.
code_paths: app/Models/PaymentTerminal.php (per-TPE fee structure — fee_percent / fee_fixed for Z-report breakdown)
concept_b_physical_tpe_at_kiosk.credentials_storage: Electron app holds TPE driver credentials locally (out of scope of this repo). Backend only sees `transaction_id` (provider-side opaque), `amount_cents`, `card_type` (label only — no PAN).
concept_b_physical_tpe_at_kiosk.fraud_gate: F-002 AMOUNT_ECHO_MISMATCH (±1¢ tolerance). Fires BEFORE any state mutation, in both OrderController::paymentConfirm and PaymentReconcileController::reconcileEntry. Without it, a compromised TPE could approve any amount and have the backend mark PAID.
concept_b_physical_tpe_at_kiosk.auth_gate: Sanctum token with kiosk:order ability required. KioskMachine table maps user_id→branch_id; cross-branch confirm rejected with 403 BEFORE F-002.
concept_b_physical_tpe_at_kiosk.idempotency_floor: lockForUpdate on FrontendOrder + UNIQUE constraint on FrontendOrder.transaction_id (verified via duplicateTransaction check at OrderController.php:184).

POS_SIMULATION_HARDWARE_actual_scope.what: Dev convenience flag that lifts the open-CashDrawerSession precondition for CASH-bearing POS sales when no physical drawer exists. Default false. Production boot-guard refuses to boot when true in production (AppServiceProvider.php:158-171 + sentinel PosSimulationHardwareProductionGuardSentinelTest).
scope_of_actual_bypass: PaymentService::recordCashOrderMovement (downgrades strict→soft when no open session).
SplitPaymentService (skip CashDrawerSessionNotOpenException for CASH tranches when no drawer).
what_it_does_NOT_bypass: F-002 AMOUNT_ECHO_MISMATCH on kiosk paymentConfirm — VERIFIED, lines 133-152 of OrderController.php read no simulation flag.
F-002 AMOUNT_ECHO_MISMATCH on reconcile — VERIFIED, PaymentReconcileController.php:172-184 reads no simulation flag.
SenangPay webhook signature verification — VERIFIED, Gateways/Senangpay.php reads no simulation flag.
NF525 fiscal_sequence_no allocation (FiscalSequenceService::next, kiosk auto-allocate at finalizePaidKioskOrder).
composition_snapshot frozen at order creation (CompositionSnapshotBuilder + PricingService SSOT).
Idempotency middleware on POST mutating routes.
POS_SIMULATION_HARDWARE_actual_scope.PAYMENT_BYPASS_MODE_is_separate: config/payment.php key `bypass.enabled` (env PAYMENT_BYPASS_MODE) is the OTHER flag for end-to-end flow validation without hardware. It DOES short-circuit the TPE driver call, with its own prod boot-guard (AppServiceProvider.php:177-183) and BypassAuditLogger structured logging. Owner D8 needs to know this flag and POS_SIMULATION_HARDWARE are independent.

architectural_clarification_critical.which_one_does_le_cayenne_use_in_v1: Per CLAUDE.md §8 + V1 Cloud-Prep insights + Le Cayenne V1 LOCAL state: physical kiosk TPE flow (Concept B). SenangPay webhook (Concept A) is wired (full impl + tests) but NOT the active production path — the kiosk's Electron app drives the local TPE and posts to /payment-confirm. failure_scenarios_audited.kiosk_handling: Electron app receives decline from local TPE driver; backend never receives a paymentConfirm POST. Order stays UNPAID + PENDING. PaymentReconcileController batch is only for APPROVED transactions that failed to confirm server-side. No state mutation backend-side on decline.
failure_scenarios_audited.observed_test_coverage: Implicit — covered by 'no paymentConfirm called → order untouched' state. No explicit decline-handling test (acceptable: decline is a no-op server-side).

failure_scenarios_audited.kiosk_handling: Electron app local timeout; if NO partial-charge condition, identical to decline path (order stays UNPAID). If partial charge condition (driver said 'sending' but no response), the Electron localStorage queue captures the txn for reconcile (PaymentReconcileController::reconcile). Backend has no timeout-specific logic — the F-008 reconcile path is timeout-agnostic.
failure_scenarios_audited.observed_test_coverage: tests/Feature/Pos/...PaymentConfirmFcmFailureTest covers FCM-side timeout but NOT a driver-side timeout. No explicit timeout test (acceptable: backend can't distinguish timeout from network-drop).

failure_scenarios_audited.kiosk_handling: Electron app POSTs paymentConfirm{transaction_id, amount_cents, card_type}. Backend: F-002 echo verify → DB::transaction → lockForUpdate → payment_status=PAID, transaction_id persisted → finalizePaidKioskOrder allocates fiscal_sequence_no + promotes to ACCEPT → AutoPrepareOnPaidPolicy may flip ACCEPT→PREPARING → OrderCreated event → outbox + FCM.

Same as 'TPE accept' (a new transaction_id is generated by the TPE driver on retry — Electron app discards the declined txn). idempotency floor (FrontendOrder.transaction_id UNIQUE + duplicateTransaction check) ensures multi-retry can never double-charge the same order.
failure_scenarios_audited.observed_test_coverage: MEDIUM — duplicateTransaction (cross-order) is tested. Same-order retry with new txn is implicit (just two separate calls with different txns).

failure_scenarios_audited.kiosk_handling: Kiosk does NOT split — only POS does. POS split flow uses payment_breakdown[] array with terminal_id per CARD tranche; SplitPaymentService validates sum + writes OrderPayment per tranche. Under simulation_hardware, CASH tranches skip cash_movement (no drawer to record).
failure_scenarios_audited.observed_test_coverage: STRONG — PosSimulationHardware4ScenariosTest S3 (2 CASH tranches) + S4 (mixed CASH + CARD).

failure_scenarios_audited.kiosk_handling: TPE locally approves → Electron tries paymentConfirm but network drops before backend response. Electron persists into localStorage (kioskHardwareService.spec.js attests). On boot + every 60s, PaymentReconcileController::reconcile batches the queue. Per-entry: F-002 echo + lockForUpdate + UNIQUE(transaction_id) + finalizePaidKioskOrder side-effect-tolerant.
failure_scenarios_audited.observed_test_coverage: STRONG — PaymentReconcileController has self-doc + Sentinels exist (tests/Feature/Frontend/...) and tests/js/kioskHardwareService.spec.js mocks the localStorage queue.

failure_scenarios_audited.kiosk_handling: Electron-side concern (drivers/USB stack). Backend is unaware. Operator workflow = unplug+replug, no orders persisted. No data integrity risk backend-side.

findings.title: Task language conflates SenangPay-online-gateway with physical-TPE-at-kiosk
findings.evidence: Task says 'TPE Senangpay hardware deep' — but app/Http/PaymentGateways/Gateways/Senangpay.php is a pure HTTP webhook handler (Concept A), while app/Models/PaymentTerminal.php::GATEWAY_SENANGPAY is a fee-tracking label on the physical-TPE side (Concept B). These are not the same code path.
findings.recommendation: Owner D8 day: clarify which Senangpay vector is being activated (A = online checkout, B = physical TPE device sold by Senangpay-the-company). The two require completely different prereq checklists.

findings.title: No production boot guard for missing senangpay_secret_key when SenangPay gateway is ACTIVE
findings.evidence: Gateways/Senangpay.php:96-104 returns HTTP 500 'misconfigured' at FIRST webhook hit if senangpay_secret_key is missing or empty. There is NO equivalent of AppServiceProvider.php:241-251 (LOYALTY_QR_SECRET boot guard) for SenangPay. If owner enables the gateway in DB (status=5) but forgets the secret, the first real charge silently fails — the deployer learns from the first customer's failed payment.
findings.recommendation: Add a boot guard in AppServiceProvider::boot() that, in production AND when PaymentGateway::where('slug','senangpay')->where('status', Activity::ENABLE)->exists(), refuses to boot if no senangpay_secret_key GatewayOption is set. Same pattern as the LOYALTY_QR_SECRET guard.

findings.title: SenangPay credentials live in DB gateway_options, NOT .env — undocumented for ops
findings.evidence: grep /Users/.../testttt for SENANGPAY_ in .env / .env.example / config returns ZERO hits. Credentials are: senangpay_merchant_id, senangpay_secret_key, senangpay_mode, senangpay_status — all in `gateway_options` table, written by admin UI (PaymentGatewayController + PaymentGatewayService::update via Dipokhalder\EnvEditor — but for SenangPay it stays in DB, not .env). This is unconventional for a Laravel app where most creds live in .env. A new ops engineer would reasonably expect SENANGPAY_SECRET_KEY in .env.
findings.recommendation: Either (a) document this in a runbook (docs/runbooks/PAYMENT_GATEWAY_SECRETS.md), or (b) refactor to read from .env first / DB fallback. For V1: (a) is scope-minimal.

findings.title: DLQ replay (Senangpay::handleFromStoredEvent) does not re-verify signature OR re-run inner business logic
findings.evidence: Self-documented at app/Http/PaymentGateways/Gateways/Senangpay.php:203-251. V1.0.1 scope-minimal: marks event PROCESSED without re-running CapturePaymentNotification upsert on status_id===1. The original live-webhook write already happened on first receipt, so the inner logic is idempotent — but a DLQ row for a successful payment is now a no-op that just leaves the queue.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.2: refactor webhook() to expose private processSenangpayEvent(array $payload, WebhookEvent $event) so replay re-runs business logic. Acknowledged as V1.0.2 backlog by the implementation author.

findings.title: F-002 AMOUNT_ECHO_MISMATCH behavior under POS_SIMULATION_HARDWARE=true was not explicitly tested
findings.evidence: Existing F-002 tests (KioskPaymentConfirmAmountTest, PaymentConfirmCrossBranchTest, etc.) do not set Config::set('pos.simulation_hardware', true). The code reading confirms the flag is OUT of OrderController::paymentConfirm scope, but no test locks the invariant against a future refactor that could widen the simulation_hardware bypass into the F-002 gate.
findings.recommendation: DELIVERED — tests/Feature/Sentinels/TpeSimulationDepthSentinelTest.php (4 test methods: under-pay, over-pay, exact-amount, reconcile-path-amount-mismatch — all under simulation_hardware=true).

findings.title: PaymentRequests/Senangpay.php has empty rules() — no server-side checkout-form validation
findings.evidence: app/Http/PaymentGateways/PaymentRequests/Senangpay.php:24-27 returns []. Means there is no FormRequest validation when a customer submits a SenangPay checkout form server-side. If the SenangPay path ever moves from 'browser redirect to senangpay.com.my' to 'server-side POST to SenangPay API', this empty rules() means no input sanitization. Currently this PaymentRequest is unused (the active flow is the webhook handler), so the gap is dormant.
findings.recommendation: If owner D8 enables a server-side checkout flow (vs hosted SenangPay page), populate rules() before going live. Otherwise leave as documented dormant code.

findings.title: WebhookEvent has no BranchScope — intentional (per Gateways/Senangpay.php:44-47) but worth flagging for multi-tenant SaaS phase
findings.evidence: WebhookEvent is global; order_id is post-mapped to inherit branch from the Order row. In V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne (single-tenant), this is fine. V2 SaaS: a multi-tenant deployment where multiple merchants share the same SenangPay account would need to scope webhook events by merchant_id → branch_id mapping at receipt time.
findings.recommendation: Document under V2 SaaS backlog (UNI-XX). No V1 action.

verdict_justification: Simulation paths are clean (5 SIM scopes + 2 BYPASS scopes all isolated to documented surfaces); NF525 invariants preserved across all code paths reviewed (composition_snapshot, fiscal_sequence_no, audit_logs, idempotency); existing test coverage is STRONG (SenangpayWebhookIdempotencyTest 6 tests + PosSimulationHardware4ScenariosTest 6 tests + PosSimulationHardwareProductionGuardSentinelTest 4 tests + KioskPaymentConfirmAmountTest 6 tests + ~6 other PaymentConfirm sentinels); BUT: (a) the task title conflates two distinct concepts (online gateway vs physical TPE) and owner needs to pick, (b) no production boot guard for missing senangpay_secret_key when gateway is enabled (parity gap with LOYALTY_QR_SECRET), (c) SenangPay credentials in DB-not-env is undocumented for ops, (d) DLQ replay self-noted V1.0.2 gap. Not RED (no integrity breach, no NF525 violation, no fraud window). Not GREEN (real-hardware switchover has documented friction that needs the D8 checklist run cleanly).
